title: Deliver deploy events to subscribers that change while they listen

cases.says: every subscriber hears every deploy, in the order they subscribed, and deploy reports how many heard it
a subscriber unsubscribed between two deploys hears only the first
a subscriber that unsubscribes itself while it handles a deploy neither breaks the delivery nor makes another subscriber miss it
a subscriber added while a deploy is delivered hears from the next deploy on, not the one in progress
a subscriber that was subscribed when a deploy began hears it, even if another subscriber unsubscribes it during the delivery

origin.section: CopyOnWriteArrayList Copies Its Array on Every Write, So Readers Iterate a Snapshot
